description: Buy (or extend by) 30 days of Premium (5.00 USDC). Call without a signature to get the x402 requirements; nothing renews automatically. Credited to the signed-in wallet, else the payer. Payment is ONE signature (no platform-fee leg): sign an accepts[] entry and call again with params._meta["x402/payment"] (PaymentPayload) or paymentSignature (base64). Settlement comes back in result._meta["x402/payment-response"].

paymentSignature.description: MAIN leg: base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload for an accepts[] entry (same as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Fallback for params._meta["x402/payment"], which wins when both are sent. Omit on the first call to get the payment requirements.

token.description: Session token (Bearer) when the MCP connection cannot carry an Authorization header

name: buy_membership
title: Buy / renew Premium
